I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message. I couldn't confirm #7190 as the ticket number for the Merlin rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines (QFL).

- Nothing in #central-team, the public files or the knowledge brain mentions Merlin or #7190.
- The public notes list only two older QFL tickets, and neither is about Merlin: #4419 (gatehouse barcode scanners) and #PD-4492 (Eau Claire kiosk SMS alerts).
- I told him I'll keep #7190 marked as unverified and won't give it out as the ticket number.
- QFL is a North team account, and the public notes name Dana Okafor as its owner, so I pointed him to her to confirm.

I didn't check #inc-qfl-sev1 or #north-team. Tobias isn't a member of either, and the rules don't let me read them on his behalf.
